About Commander Tech Rentals

Our story

From one Harare cottage to 14 suburbs.

Commander Tech Rentals started with a single thatched cottage in Avondale and a WhatsApp number. Today the platform connects hundreds of landlords and tenants across Harare — still built on the same Zimbabwean foundations: honesty, community and homes that actually work.

  • 2024Founded — first listing goes live in Avondale.
  • 2025100 tenants housed — verification team launches; borehole & ZESA details added to every listing.
  • 2026Signature portal — landlord & tenant dashboards, tracked payments, admin oversight. 300+ tenants housed.

Why choose Commander Tech

  • Verified homes. Every property inspected and photographed by our team.
  • The details that matter. Boreholes, tanks, prepaid ZESA, solar and fibre — always listed.
  • No hidden fees. Transparent pricing for tenants and landlords.
  • People, not bots. WhatsApp support on 0788 386 485, Mon–Sat.

Built with accessibility in mind

This portal targets WCAG 2.1 AA: full keyboard navigation, screen-reader landmarks, visible focus, high-contrast palettes and reduced-motion support on every screen.
